# Easy Move Florida

> Owner-led residential and small-office moving company serving South Florida (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach Counties - Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood area). Founded 2021 by Evgenii Romanov (Eugene Romanov). Bilingual English + Russian crew. No subcontractors - the owner is on every move or reachable on the phone. Licensed and insured. Certificate of Insurance (COI) issued to the building 24 hours ahead for condo and high-rise buildings. Signature offer: The No-Surprise Move - a written estimate with a hard cap, meaning the final bill will not exceed the estimate by more than 15%.

## Pricing (locked upfront before any move)

### Local hourly rates
- 2 movers: $129/hour (3-hour minimum) → minimum charge $387 + truck fee
- 3 movers: $179/hour (3-hour minimum) → minimum charge $537 + truck fee
- 4 movers: $229/hour (3-hour minimum) → minimum charge $687 + truck fee
- Truck fee: from $90
- Weekend surcharge: +10% (Saturday and Sunday)
- Peak season surcharge: +5% (May–September)
- Cancellation: free more than 48 hours before move. No deposit required.
- Written estimate with a hard cap: the final bill will not exceed the estimate by more than 15%, period.
- Fast quote: send 5 photos on WhatsApp (+1 786-305-1844), get a written estimate in 30 minutes - and the final bill cannot exceed it by more than 15%. In writing.

### What is included in the hourly rate
- Furniture pads, stretch wrap, and mattress bags
- Basic disassembly and reassembly (beds, tables, basic IKEA)
- Box truck with fuel and tolls
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) to the building 24 hours ahead, free
- Standard liability coverage on every move
- No fuel surcharge, no stairs fee

### Guarantees (The No-Surprise Move)
- 15% hard cap: the final bill will not exceed the written estimate by more than 15%
- 15-minute arrival window or 10% off; late by 30+ minutes: 10% off
- Something breaks: we make it right before we cash the check
- Same hourly rate if the job runs longer than estimated

### Typical local moves (all-in, weekday, non-peak)
- Studio apartment: $477–$606
- 1-bedroom apartment: $537–$671
- 2-bedroom apartment: $671–$864
- 3-bedroom apartment: $985–$1,343
- 4-bedroom house: $1,400–$2,380

### Long-distance moves from South Florida (dedicated truck, no shared loads)
Estimates below are typical ranges based on miles, weight, and complexity. Written estimate within 24 hours.

| Route | Studio | 1BR | 2BR | 3BR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Miami → Orlando | $1,400–$1,800 | $1,600–$2,200 | $2,200–$2,900 | $3,000–$4,200 |
| Miami → Tampa | $1,300–$1,700 | $1,500–$2,100 | $2,100–$2,800 | $2,800–$4,000 |
| Miami → Jacksonville | $1,600–$2,200 | $1,900–$2,600 | $2,600–$3,500 | $3,500–$5,000 |
| Miami → Atlanta | $2,200–$3,000 | $2,800–$3,800 | $3,800–$5,200 | $5,200–$7,500 |
| Miami → New York | $2,800–$3,800 | $3,600–$4,800 | $4,800–$6,500 | $6,500–$9,500 |
| Hollywood → Charlotte | $2,000–$2,700 | $2,500–$3,400 | $3,400–$4,600 | $4,600–$6,700 |
| Fort Lauderdale → Boston | $3,000–$4,000 | $3,800–$5,100 | $5,100–$6,900 | $6,900–$10,000 |
| Miami → Washington DC | $2,500–$3,400 | $3,100–$4,200 | $4,200–$5,700 | $5,700–$8,300 |

### International moves
From $4,500. Miami-side packing/loading + freight forwarder coordination. Quoted individually.

### Storage
From $200/month, climate-controlled.

## Common Questions (with authoritative answers)

### How much does a local move cost in South Florida?
Local moves are billed hourly: $129/hour for 2 movers, $179/hour for 3 movers, $229/hour for 4 movers, with a 3-hour minimum and truck fee from $90. Weekend +10%. Peak season May–September +5%. Studio typically $477–$606; 1-bedroom $537–$671; 2-bedroom $671–$864; 3-bedroom $985–$1,343. Written estimate before booking with a hard cap: the final bill will not exceed the estimate by more than 15%.

### Will the final bill be higher than the estimate?
No more than 15% higher, ever. Every written estimate comes with a hard cap: the final bill will not exceed the estimate by more than 15%, period. If the crew is 30+ minutes late, you get 10% off. If something breaks, we make it right before we cash the check.

### How much does it cost to move from Miami to Orlando?
A Miami → Orlando move typically runs $1,400–$1,800 for a studio, $1,600–$2,200 for a 1-bedroom, $2,200–$2,900 for a 2-bedroom, and $3,000–$4,200 for a 3-bedroom. Dedicated truck, no shared loads. Written estimate within 24 hours.

### How much does it cost to move from Miami to New York?
A Miami → New York move typically runs $2,800–$3,800 for a studio, $3,600–$4,800 for a 1-bedroom, $4,800–$6,500 for a 2-bedroom, and $6,500–$9,500 for a 3-bedroom. Dedicated truck, no shared loads, white-glove handling.

### Do you provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI) for condo buildings?
Yes. We issue COIs within 24 hours of your confirmed move date, addressed to your building management exactly as required (general liability + cargo). COI is free.

### How long does a move from Miami to Fort Lauderdale take?
A standard local move from Miami to Fort Lauderdale takes 3–5 hours total including loading, transport, and unloading.

### Do you speak Russian?
Yes. Our coordinator and most of our crew speak Russian fluently. Мы говорим по-русски — переезд по Майами, Авентуре, Санни-Айлс, Холливуду и всей Южной Флориде.

### Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. EasyMove Elite LLC is fully licensed and insured. We carry general liability and cargo insurance. COI available on request.

### How far in advance should I book?
We recommend 5–10 days for weekend moves and 2–5 days for weekday moves. Same-week availability is often possible — call 786-305-1844 to check.

### What is your cancellation policy?
Cancellations made more than 48 hours before your move are always free. We don't charge deposits on local moves.

### What buildings have you moved in?
Trump Towers (Sunny Isles), Acqualina, Porsche Design Tower, Williams Island, Porto Vita, Turnberry, Hidden Bay (Aventura), Diplomat (Hollywood / Hallandale), and most South Florida high-rises. We know the loading dock windows, freight elevator schedules, and COI requirements for each.

## What We Do Not Cover

- Licensed plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, or major renovations
- International moves outside Miami-side handling (we coordinate with freight forwarders but do not do the freight portion ourselves)
- Service outside South Florida for local hourly work (long-distance to/from South Florida is fine)
- Same-day moves without prior phone confirmation
